# Polished Mastering

> Metal & Gothic audio mastering studio based in Germany. Every project starts with a full written audio audit before mastering begins.

Polished specializes in mastering for Black Metal, Death Metal, Doom, Gothic and Metalcore/Djent. Every package includes a full audio audit (frequency spectrum, dynamics, stereo image, phase, loudness) and unlimited revisions. No AI mastering — every track is analyzed and mastered personally by Tim Borchert, who holds a degree in Systematic Musicology from the University of Hamburg.

## Services
- Stereo Mastering (single track) — from €79
- Stem Mastering — from €129
- EP Mastering (up to 5 tracks) — €349
- Album Mastering (up to 10 tracks) — €799

## Service area
Germany, Austria, Switzerland, worldwide (fully remote/online studio).
